newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal unemployment drops 5.4 pct yr/yr May.
newsitem.headline: Portugal unemployment drops 5.4 pct yr/yr May.

text.p: The number of people out of work in Portugal fell 5.4 percent year-on-year in May to 451,761, the Employment Ministry said on Thursday.
The May figure was also 3.3 percent down on the previous month.
Job supply has been rising since December, with 11,243 jobs created in May alone, a year-on-year rise of 28.1 percent, the ministry said.

The ministry gave no figure for the unemployment rate in May. The last official unemployment figures from the National Statistics Institute showed 7.3 percent of the working population out of a job in March, down from 7.2 percent at the end of 1996.
